svg.title: Identity the government already trusts
svg.desc: Integrated Zalopay with VNeID, Vietnam's national digital identity, so users verify once instead of re-uploading ID papers. Owned the success metric, set per-OS targets, rolled out NFC and Smart Resume. eKYC · end-to-end onboarding success x4.

re-uploading ID papers. Owned the success metric, set per-OS targets, rolled out NFC and Smart Resume.
